verses.en: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.fr: Paroles d''Amos, l''un des bergers de Tekoa, visions qu''il eut sur Israël, au temps d''Ozias, roi de Juda, et au temps de Jéroboam, fils de Joas, roi d''Israël, deux ans avant le tremblement de terre.
verses.am: በቴቁሔ ከላም ጠባቂዎች መካከል የነበረ አሞጽ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዖዝያን ዘመን፥ በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በዮአስ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ዘመን፥ የምድር መናወጥ ከሆነበቱ ከሁለት ዓመት በፊት ስለ እስራኤል ያየው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And he said, The Lord will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
verses.fr: Il dit: De Sion l''Eternel rugit, De Jérusalem il fait entendre sa voix. Les pâturages des bergers sont dans le deuil, Et le sommet du Carmel est desséché.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ሆኖ ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ ይጮኻል፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሆኖ ቃሉን ይሰጣል፤ የእረኞችም ማሰማርያዎች ያለቅሳሉ፥ የቀርሜሎስም ራስ ይደርቃል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes de Damas, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''ils ont foulé Galaad sous des traîneaux de fer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ገለዓድን በብረት መንኰራኵር አሂዶአልና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የደማስቆ ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.fr: J''enverrai le feu dans la maison de Hazaël, Et il dévorera les palais de Ben-Hadad.
verses.am: በአዛሄል ቤት እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ የወልደ አዴርንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች።

verses.en: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je briserai les verrous de Damas, J''exterminerai de Bikath-Aven les habitants, Et de Beth-Eden celui qui tient le sceptre; Et le peuple de Syrie sera mené captif à Kir, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የደማስቆንም መወርወሪያ እሰብራለሁ፥ ተቀማጮችንም ከአዌን ሸለቆ አጠፋለሁ፥ በትር የያዘውንም ከዔደን ቤት አጠፋለሁ፤ የሶርያም ሕዝብ ወደ ቂር ይማረካል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes de Gaza, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''ils ont fait une foule de captifs pour les livrer à Edom.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለኤዶምያስ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ ምርኮኞችን ሁሉ ማርከዋልና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የጋዛ ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
verses.fr: J''enverrai le feu dans les murs de Gaza, Et il en dévorera les palais.
verses.am: በጋዛ ቅጥር ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም ትበላለች።

verses.en: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: J''exterminerai d''Asdod les habitants, Et d''Askalon celui qui tient le sceptre; Je tournerai ma main contre Ekron, Et le reste des Philistins périra, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ተቀማጮችን ከአዛጦን አጠፋለሁ፥ በትር የያዘውንም ከአስቀሎና አጠፋለሁ፤ እጄንም በአቃሮን ላይ እመልሳለሁ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም የቀሩት ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes de Tyr, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''ils ont livré à Edom une foule de captifs, Sans se souvenir de l''alliance fraternelle.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ምርኮኞችን ሁሉ ለኤዶምያስ አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋልና፥ የወንድሞችንም ቃል ኪዳን አላሰቡምና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የጢሮስ ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.fr: J''enverrai le feu dans les murs de Tyr, Et il en dévorera les palais.
verses.am: በጢሮስ ቅጥር ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም ትበላለች።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes d''Edom, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''il a poursuivi ses frères avec l''épée, En étouffant sa compassion, Parce que sa colère déchire toujours, Et qu''il garde éternellement sa fureur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወንድሙን በሰይፍ አሳድዶታልና፥ ርኅራኄንም ሁሉ ጥሎአልና፥ ቍጣውም ሁልጊዜ ቀድዶአልና፥ መዓቱንም ለዘላለም ጠብቆአልና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የኤዶምያስ ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
verses.fr: J''enverrai le feu dans Théman, Et il dévorera les palais de Botsra.
verses.am: በቴማን ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ የባሶራንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes des enfants d''Ammon, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''ils ont fendu le ventre des femmes enceintes de Galaad, Afin d''agrandir leur territoire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዳርቻቸውን ያሰፉ ዘንድ የገለዓድን እርጕዞች ቀድደዋልና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የአሞን ልጆች ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
verses.fr: J''allumerai le feu dans les murs de Rabba, Et il en dévorera les palais, Au milieu des cris de guerre au jour du combat, Au milieu de l''ouragan au jour de la tempête;
verses.am: በረባት ቅጥር ላይ እሳትን አነድዳለሁ፤ በሰልፍም ቀን በጩኸት በዐውሎ ነፋስም ቀን በሁከት አዳራሾችዋን ትበላለች፤

verses.en: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Et leur roi s''en ira en captivité, Lui, et ses chefs avec lui, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ንጉሣቸውም ከአለቆቹ ጋር በአንድነት ይማረካል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes de Moab, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''il a brûlé, calciné les os du roi d''Edom.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የኤዶምያስን ንጉሥ አጥንት አመድ እስኪሆን ድረስ አቃጥሎታልና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የሞዓብ ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
verses.fr: J''enverrai le feu dans Moab, Et il dévorera les palais de Kerijoth; Et Moab périra au milieu du tumulte, Au milieu des cris de guerre et du bruit de la trompette.
verses.am: በሞዓብ ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ የቂርዮትንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች፤ ሞዓብም በውካታና በጩኸት በመለከትም ድምፅ ይሞታል፤

verses.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: J''exterminerai de son sein le juge, Et je tuerai tous ses chefs avec lui, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፈራጅንም ከመካከልዋ አጠፋለሁ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አለቆችዋን ሁሉ እገድላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the Lord, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes de Juda, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''ils ont méprisé la loi de l''Eternel Et qu''ils n''ont pas gardé ses ordonnances, Parce qu''ils ont été égarés par les idoles mensongères Après lesquelles leurs pères ont marché.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ጥለዋልና፥ ትእዛዙንም አልጠበቁምና፥ አባቶቻቸውም የተከተሉት ሐሰታቸው አስቶአቸዋልና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የይሁዳ ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: J''enverrai le feu dans Juda, Et il dévorera les palais de Jérusalem.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A cause de trois crimes d''Israël, Même de quatre, je ne révoque pas mon arrêt, Parce qu''ils ont vendu le juste pour de l''argent, Et le pauvre pour une paire de souliers.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጻድቁን ስለ ብር፥ ችጋረኛውንም ስለ አንድ ጥንድ ጫማ ሽጠውታልና ስለ ሦስት ወይም ስለ አራት የእስራኤል ኃጢአት መቅሠፍቴን ከማድረግ አልመለስም።

verses.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
verses.fr: Ils aspirent à voir la poussière de la terre sur la tête des misérables, Et ils violent le droit des malheureux. Le fils et le père vont vers la même fille, Afin de profaner mon saint nom.
verses.am: የድሆችን ራስ በምድር ትቢያ ላይ ይረግጣሉ፥ የትሑታንንም መንገድ ያጣምማሉ፤ ቅዱሱንም ስሜን ያረክሱ ዘንድ አባትና ልጁ ወደ አንዲት ሴት ይገባሉ፤

verses.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
verses.fr: Ils s''étendent près de chaque autel sur des vêtements pris en gage, Et ils boivent dans la maison de leurs dieux le vin de ceux qu''ils condamnent.
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም ሁሉ አጠገብ ለመያዣነት በተወሰደው ልብስ ላይ ይተኛሉ፤ በአምላካቸውም ቤት ውስጥ በካሣ የተወሰደውን ወይን ጠጅ ይጠጣሉ።

verses.en: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.fr: Et pourtant j''ai détruit devant eux les Amoréens, Dont la hauteur égalait celle des cèdres, Et la force celle des chênes; J''ai détruit leurs fruits en haut, Et leurs racines en bas.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ቁመቱ እንደ ዝግባ ቁመት፥ ብርታቱም እንደ ኮምበል ዛፍ የነበረውን አሞራዊውን ከፊታቸው አጠፋሁ፤ ፍሬውንም ከላዩ፥ ሥሩንም ከታቹ አጠፋሁ።

verses.en: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.fr: Et pourtant je vous ai fait monter du pays d''Egypte, Et je vous ai conduits quarante ans dans le désert, Pour vous mettre en possession du pays des Amoréens.
verses.am: የአሞራዊውንም ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ ከግብጽ ምድር አወጣኋችሁ፥ በምድረ በዳም አርባ ዓመት መራኋችሁ።

verses.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the Lord.
verses.fr: J''ai suscité parmi vos fils des prophètes, Et parmi vos jeunes hommes des nazaréens. N''en est-il pas ainsi, enfants d''Israël? dit l''Eternel...
verses.am: ከወንድ ልጆቻችሁም ነቢያትን፥ ከጐበዛዝቶቻችሁም ናዝራውያንን አስነሣሁ፤ እናንተ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ ይህ እንደዚህ አይደለምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.fr: Et vous avez fait boire du vin aux nazaréens! Et aux prophètes vous avez donné cet ordre: Ne prophétisez pas!
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ናዝራውያኑን የወይን ጠጅ አጠጣችኋቸው፤ ነቢያቱንም። ትንቢትን አትናገሩ ብላችሁ አዘዛችኋቸው።

verses.en: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
verses.fr: Voici, je vous écraserai, Comme foule la terre un chariot chargé de gerbes.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ነዶ የተሞላች ሰረገላ እንደምትደቀድቅ እንዲሁ እደቀድቃችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
verses.fr: Celui qui est agile ne pourra fuir, Celui qui a de la force ne pourra s''en servir, Et l''homme vaillant ne sauvera pas sa vie;
verses.am: ከርዋጪም ሽሽት ይጠፋል፥ ብርቱውም በብርታቱ አይበረታም፥ ኃያሉም ነፍሱን አያድንም፤

verses.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
verses.fr: Celui qui manie l''arc ne résistera pas, Celui qui a les pieds légers n''échappera pas, Et le cavalier ne sauvera pas sa vie;
verses.am: ቀስተኛውም አይቆምም፥ ፈጣኑም አይድንም፥ ፈረሰኛውም ነፍሱን አያድንም፤

verses.en: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Le plus courageux des guerriers S''enfuira nu dans ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በኃያላኑም መካከል ልበ ሙሉው በዚያ ቀን ዕራቁቱን ሆኖ ይሸሻል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.fr: Ecoutez cette parole que l''Eternel prononce contre vous, enfants d''Israël, Contre toute la famille que j''ai fait monter du pays d''Egypte!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእናንተ፥ ከግብጽ ምድር ባወጣሁት ወገን ሁሉ ላይ የተናገረውን ይህን ቃል ስሙ፤

verses.en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
verses.fr: Je vous ai choisis, vous seuls parmi toutes les familles de la terre; C''est pourquoi je vous châtierai pour toutes vos iniquités.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎአል። እኔ ከምድር ወገን ሁሉ እናንተን ብቻችሁን አውቄአችኋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ ስለ ኃጢአታችሁ ሁሉ እበቀላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
verses.fr: Deux hommes marchent-ils ensemble, Sans en être convenus?
verses.am: በውኑ ሁለት ሰዎች ሳይስማሙ በአንድነት ይሄዳሉን?

verses.en: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
verses.fr: Le lion rugit-il dans la forêt, Sans avoir une proie? Le lionceau pousse-t-il des cris du fond de sa tanière, Sans avoir fait une capture?
verses.am: ወይስ አንበሳ የሚነጥቀው ነገር ሳያገኝ በጫካ ውስጥ ያገሣልን? ወይስ የአንበሳ ደቦል አንዳች ሳይዝ በመደቡ ሆኖ ይጮኻልን?

verses.en: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
verses.fr: L''oiseau tombe-t-il dans le filet qui est à terre, Sans qu''il y ait un piège? Le filet s''élève-t-il de terre, Sans qu''il y ait rien de pris?
verses.am: ወይስ ወፍ፥ አጥማጅ ከሌለው፥ በምድር ላይ በወጥመድ ይያዛልን? ወይስ ወስፈንጠር አንዳች ሳይዝ ከምድር ይፈነጠራልን?

verses.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?
verses.fr: Sonne-t-on de la trompette dans une ville, Sans que le peuple soit dans l''épouvante? Arrive-t-il un malheur dans une ville, Sans que l''Eternel en soit l''auteur?
verses.am: ወይስ በከተማ ውስጥ መለከት ሲነፋ ሕዝቡ አይፈራምን? ወይስ ክፉ ነገር በከተማ ላይ የመጣ እንደ ሆነ ያደረገው እግዚአብሔር አይደለምን?

verses.en: Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
verses.fr: Car le Seigneur, l''Eternel, ne fait rien Sans avoir révélé son secret à ses serviteurs les prophètes.
verses.am: በእውነት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ምሥጢሩን ለባሪያዎቹ ለነቢያት ካልነገረ በቀር ምንም አያደርግም።

verses.en: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
verses.fr: Le lion rugit: qui ne serait effrayé? Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, parle: qui ne prophétiserait?
verses.am: አንበሳው አገሣ፤ የማይፈራ ማን ነው? ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ተናገረ፤ ትንቢት የማይናገር ማን ነው?

verses.en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
verses.fr: Faites retentir votre voix dans les palais d''Asdod Et dans les palais du pays d''Egypte, Et dites: Rassemblez-vous sur les montagnes de Samarie, Et voyez quelle immense confusion au milieu d''elle, Quelles violences dans son sein!
verses.am: በአዛጦን አዳራሾችና በግብጽ ምድር አዳራሾች አውሩና። በሰማርያ ተራሮች ላይ ተሰብሰቡ፥ በውስጥዋም የሆነውን ታላቁን ውካታ፥ በመካከልዋም ያለውን ግፍ ተመልከቱ በሉ።

verses.en: For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
verses.fr: Ils ne savent pas agir avec droiture, dit l''Eternel, Ils entassent dans leurs palais les produits de la violence et de la rapine.
verses.am: ግፍንና ቅሚያን በአዳራሾቻቸው የሚያከማቹት ቅን ነገርን ያደርጉ ዘንድ አያውቁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: L''ennemi investira le pays, Il détruira ta force, Et tes palais seront pillés.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በምድሪቱ ዙሪያ ጠላት ይመጣል፤ ብርታትሽንም ከአንቺ ያወርዳል፥ አዳራሾችሽም ይበዘበዛሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Comme le berger arrache de la gueule du lion Deux jambes ou un bout d''oreille, Ainsi se sauveront les enfants d''Israël qui sont assis dans Samarie A l''angle d''un lit et sur des tapis de damas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እረኛ ከአንበሳ አፍ ሁለት እግርን ወይም የጆሮን ጫፍ እንደሚያድን፥ እንዲሁ በሰማርያ በአልጋ ማዕዘን፥ በደማስቆም በምንጣፍ ላይ የተቀመጡት የእስራኤል ልጆች ይድናሉ።

verses.en: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord God, the God of hosts,
verses.fr: Ecoutez, et déclarez ceci à la maison de Jacob! Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées.
verses.am: ስሙ፥ በያዕቆብም ቤት ላይ መስክሩ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
verses.fr: Le jour où je punirai Israël pour ses transgressions, Je frapperai sur les autels de Béthel; Les cornes de l''autel seront brisées, Et tomberont à terre.
verses.am: እስራኤልን ስለ ኃጢአቱ በምበቀልበት ቀን የቤቴልን መሠዊያዎች ደግሞ እበቀላለሁ፤ የመሠዊያው ቀንዶች ይሰበራሉ፥ ወደ ምድርም ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je renverserai les maisons d''hiver et les maisons d''été; Les palais d''ivoire périront, Les maisons des grands disparaîtront, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የክረምቱንና የበጋውን ቤት እመታለሁ፤ በዝሆንም ጥርስ የተለበጡት ቤቶች ይጠፋሉ፥ ታላላቆችም ቤቶች ይፈርሳሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
verses.fr: Ecoutez cette parole, génisses de Basan qui êtes sur la montagne de Samarie, Vous qui opprimez les misérables, qui écrasez les indigents, Et qui dites à vos maris: Apportez, et buvons!
verses.am: በሰማርያ ተራራ የምትኖሩ፥ ድሆችንም የምትበድሉ፥ ችጋረኞችንም የምታሰጨንቁ፥ ጌቶቻቸውንም። አምጡ እንጠጣ የምትሉ እናንተ የባሳን ላሞች ሆይ፥ ይህን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: The Lord God hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, l''a juré par sa sainteté: Voici, les jours viendront pour vous Où l''on vous enlèvera avec des crochets, Et votre postérité avec des hameçons;
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። እናንተን በሰልፍ ዕቃ፥ ቅሬታችሁንም በመቃጥን የሚወስዱበት ቀን፥ እነሆ፥ በላያችሁ ይመጣል ብሎ በቅዱስነቱ ምሎአል።

verses.en: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous sortirez par les brèches, chacune devant soi, Et vous serez jetées dans la forteresse, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እያንዳንዳችሁ በየፊታችሁ በተነደለ ስፍራ ትወጣላችሁ፤ በሬማንም ትጣላላችሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
verses.fr: Allez à Béthel, et péchez! Allez à Guilgal, et péchez davantage! Offrez vos sacrifices chaque matin, Et vos dîmes tous les trois jours!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ ይህን ወድዳችኋልና ወደ ቤቴል ኑና ኃጢአትን ሥሩ፤ ወደ ጌልገላ ኑና ኃጢአትን አብዙ፤ በየማለዳውም መሥዋዕታችሁን፥ በየሦስተኛውም ቀን አሥራታችሁን አቅርቡ፤

verses.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Faites vos sacrifices d''actions de grâces avec du levain! Proclamez, publiez vos offrandes volontaires! Car c''est là ce que vous aimez, enfants d''Israël, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እርሾ ካለበትም የምስጋናውን መሥዋዕት አቅርቡ፥ በፈቃዳችሁም የምታቀርቡትን አውጁና አውሩ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Et moi, je vous ai envoyé la famine dans toutes vos villes, Le manque de pain dans toutes vos demeures. Malgré cela, vous n''êtes pas revenus à moi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በከተማችሁ ሁሉ ጥርስን ማጥራት፥ በስፍራችሁም ሁሉ እንጀራን ማጣት ሰጠኋችሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
verses.fr: Et moi, je vous ai refusé la pluie, Lorsqu''il y avait encore trois mois jusqu''à la moisson; J''ai fait pleuvoir sur une ville, Et je n''ai pas fait pleuvoir sur une autre ville; Un champ a reçu la pluie, Et un autre qui ne l''a pas reçue s''est desséché.
verses.am: መከር ሳይደርስ ገና ከሦስት ወር በፊት ዝናብ ከለከልኋችሁ፤ በአንድም ከተማ ላይ አዘነብሁ፥ በሌላውም ከተማ ላይ እንዳይዘንብ አደረግሁ፤ በአንድ ወገን ዘነበ፥ ያልዘነበበትም ወገን ደረቀ።

verses.en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Deux, trois villes sont allées vers une autre pour boire de l''eau, Et elles n''ont point apaisé leur soif. Malgré cela, vous n''êtes pas revenus à moi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሁለት ወይም የሦስት ከተሞች ሰዎች ወደ አንዲት ከተማ ወኃ ይጠጡ ዘንድ ሄዱ፥ ነገር ግን አልረኩም፤ እናንተ ግን ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je vous ai frappés par la rouille et par la nielle; Vos nombreux jardins, vos vignes, vos figuiers et vos oliviers Ont été dévorés par les sauterelles. Malgré cela, vous n''êtes pas revenus à moi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዋግና በአረማሞ መታኋችሁ፤ የአታክልቶቻችሁንም ብዛት ወይኖቻችሁንም በለሶቻችሁንም ወይራዎቻችሁንም ተምች በልቶአል፤ እናንተ ግን ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: J''ai envoyé parmi vous la peste, comme en Egypte; J''ai tué vos jeunes gens par l''épée, Et laissé prendre vos chevaux; J''ai fait monter à vos narines l''infection de votre camp. Malgré cela, vous n''êtes pas revenus à moi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በግብጽ እንደ ነበረው ቸነፈርን ሰደድሁባችሁ፤ ጐበዛዝቶቻችሁን በሰይፍ ገደልሁ፥ ፈረሶቻችሁንም አስማረክሁ፤ የሰፈራችሁንም ግማት ወደ አፍንጫችሁ አወጣሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je vous ai bouleversés, Comme Sodome et Gomorrhe, que Dieu détruisit; Et vous avez été comme un tison arraché de l''incendie. Malgré cela, vous n''êtes pas revenus à moi, dit l''Eternel...
verses.am: ሰዶምንና ገሞራን እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጣቸው፥ እንዲሁ ገለበጥኋችሁ፥ እናንተም ከእሳት ውስጥ እንደ ተነጠቀ ትንታግ ሆናችሁ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je te traiterai de la même manière, Israël; Et puisque je te traiterai de la même manière, Prépare-toi à la rencontre de ton Dieu, O Israël!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንደዚህ አደርግብሃለሁ፤ እስራኤልም ሆይ፥ እንደዚህ ስለማደርግብህ አምላክህን ለመገናኘት ተዘጋጅ።

verses.en: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The Lord, The God of hosts, is his name.
verses.fr: Car voici celui qui a formé les montagnes et créé le vent, Et qui fait connaître à l''homme ses pensées, Celui qui change l''aurore en ténèbres, Et qui marche sur les hauteurs de la terre: Son nom est l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ተራሮችን የሠራ፥ ነፋስንም የፈጠረ፥ የልቡንም አሳብ ለሰው የሚነግር፥ ንጋትን ጨለማ የሚያደርግ፥ በምድርም ከፍታዎች ላይ የሚረግጥ፥ ስሙ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
verses.fr: Ecoutez cette parole, Cette complainte que je prononce sur vous, Maison d''Israël!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በእናንተ ላይ ለሙሾ የማነሣውን ይህን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
verses.fr: Elle est tombée, elle ne se relèvera plus, La vierge d''Israël; Elle est couchée par terre, Nul ne la relève.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ድንግል ወደቀች፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አትነሣም፤ በምድርዋ ላይ ተጣለች፥ የሚያስነሣትም የለም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: La ville qui mettait en campagne mille hommes N''en conservera que cent, Et celle qui mettait en campagne cent hommes N''en conservera que dix, pour la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላልና። ሺህ ከሚወጣባት ከተማ መቶ ይቀርላታል፥ መቶም ከሚወጣባት ከተማ ለእስራኤል ቤት አሥር ይቀርላታል።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel à la maison d''Israël: Cherchez-moi, et vous vivrez!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለእስራኤል ቤት እንዲህ ይላልና። እኔን ፈልጉ፥ በሕይወትም ትኖራላችሁ፤

verses.en: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
verses.fr: Ne cherchez pas Béthel, N''allez pas à Guilgal, Ne passez pas à Beer-Schéba. Car Guilgal sera captif, Et Béthel anéanti.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጌልገላ ፈጽሞ ትማረካለችና፥ ቤቴልም ከንቱ ትሆናለችና ቤቴልን አትፈልጉ፥ ወደ ጌልገላም አትግቡ፥ ወደ ቤርሳቤህም አትለፉ።

verses.en: Seek the Lord, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.
verses.fr: Cherchez l''Eternel, et vous vivrez! Craignez qu''il ne saisisse comme un feu la maison de Joseph, Et que ce feu ne la dévore, sans personne à Béthel pour l''éteindre,
verses.am: በዮሴፍ ቤት እሳት እንዳትቃጠል፥ በቤቴል የሚያጠፋትም ሳይኖር እንዳትበላ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉ፥ በሕይወትም ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
verses.fr: O vous qui changez le droit en absinthe, Et qui foulez à terre la justice!
verses.am: ፍርድን ወደ እሬት የምትለውጡ፥ ጽድቅንም በምድር ላይ የምትጥሉ እናንተ ሆይ፥

verses.en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name:
verses.fr: Il a créé les Pléiades et l''Orion, Il change les ténèbres en aurore, Il obscurcit le jour pour en faire la nuit, Il appelle les eaux de la mer, Et les répand à la surface de la terre: L''Eternel est son nom.
verses.am: ሰባቱን ከዋክብትና ኦሪዮን የተባለውን ኮከብ የፈጠረውን፥ የሞትን ጥላ ወደ ንጋት የሚለውጠውን፥ ቀኑንም በሌሊት የሚያጨልመውን፥ የባሕሩንም ውኆች ጠርቶ በምድር ፊት ላይ የሚያፈስሳቸውን፥

verses.en: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
verses.fr: Il fait lever la ruine sur les puissants, Et la ruine vient sur les forteresses.
verses.am: አምባውም እንዲፈርስ በብርቱ ላይ የድንገት ጥፋት የሚያመጣውን ፈልጉ፤ ስሙ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
verses.fr: Ils haïssent celui qui les reprend à la porte, Et ils ont en horreur celui qui parle sincèrement.
verses.am: በበሩ አደባባይ የሚገሥጸውን ጠሉ፥ እውነትም የሚናገረውን ተጸየፉ።

verses.en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.
verses.fr: Aussi, parce que vous avez foulé le misérable, Et que vous avez pris de lui du blé en présent, Vous avez bâti des maisons en pierres de taille, Mais vous ne les habiterez pas; Vous avez planté d''excellentes vignes, Mais vous n''en boirez pas le vin.
verses.am: ድሀውንም ደብድባችኋልና፥ የስንዴውንም ቀረጥ ከእርሱ ወስዳችኋልና ከተጠረበ ድንጋይ ቤቶችን ሠርታችኋል፥ ነገር ግን አትቀመጡባቸውም፤ ያማሩ የወይን ቦታዎች ተክላችኋል፥ ነገር ግን ከወይን ጠጃቸው አትጠጡም።

verses.en: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
verses.fr: Car, je le sais, vos crimes sont nombreux, Vos péchés se sont multipliés; Vous opprimez le juste, vous recevez des présents, Et vous violez à la porte le droit des pauvres.
verses.am: ጻድቁን የምታስጨንቁ፥ ጉቦንም የምትቀበሉ፥ በበሩም አደባባይ የችጋረኛውን ፍርድ የምታጣምሙ እናንተ ሆይ፥ በደላችሁ እንዴት እንደ በዛ፥ ኃጢአታችሁም እንዴት እንደ ጸና እኔ አውቃለሁና።

verses.en: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi, en des temps comme ceux-ci, le sage se tait; Car ces temps sont mauvais.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ክፉ ዘመን ነውና በዚያ ዘመን አስተዋይ የሚሆን ዝም ይላል።

verses.en: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the Lord, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
verses.fr: Recherchez le bien et non le mal, afin que vous viviez, Et qu''ainsi l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées, soit avec vous, Comme vous le dites.
verses.am: በሕይወት ትኖሩ ዘንድ መልካሙን እንጂ ክፉውን አትፈልጉ፤ እንዲህም እናንተ እንደ ተናገራችሁ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር ይሆናል።

verses.en: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the Lord God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
verses.fr: Haïssez le mal et aimez le bien, Faites régner à la porte la justice; Et peut-être l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées, aura pitié Des restes de Joseph.
verses.am: ክፉውን ጥሉ፥ መልካሙንም ውደዱ፥ በበሩም አደባባይ ፍርድን አጽኑ፤ ምናልባት የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለዮሴፍ ቅሬታ ይራራ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Therefore the Lord, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées, le Seigneur; Dans toutes les places on se lamentera, Dans toutes les rues on dira: Hélas! hélas! On appellera le laboureur au deuil, Et aux lamentations ceux qui disent des complaintes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በየአደባባዩ ሁሉ ላይ ዋይታ ይሆናል፤ በየመንገዱም ሁሉ ላይ ወዮ ወዮ ይባላል፤ ገበሬዎቹም ወደ ልቅሶ፥ አልቃሾቹም ወደ ዋይታ ይጠራሉ።

verses.en: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Dans toutes les vignes on se lamentera, Lorsque je passerai au milieu de toi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በመካከልህ አልፋለሁና በወይኑ ቦታ ሁሉ ልቅሶ ይሆናል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord! to what end is it for you? the day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui désirent le jour de l''Eternel! Qu''attendez-vous du jour de l''Eternel? Il sera ténèbres et non lumière.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቀን ለምትፈልጉ ወዮላችሁ! የእግዚአብሔርን ቀን ለምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ጨለማ ነው እንጂ ብርሃን አይደለም።

verses.en: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
verses.fr: Vous serez comme un homme qui fuit devant un lion Et que rencontre un ours, Qui gagne sa demeure, appuie sa main sur la muraille, Et que mord un serpent.
verses.am: ከአንበሳ ፊት እንደ ሸሸ ድብም እንዳገኘው ሰው፥ ወይም ወደ ቤት ገብቶ እጁን በግድግዳ ላይ እንዳስደገፈና እባብ እንደ ነደፈው ሰው ነው።

verses.en: Shall not the day of the Lord be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
verses.fr: Le jour de l''Eternel n''est-il pas ténèbres et non lumière? N''est-il pas obscur et sans éclat?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ብርሃን ሳይሆን ጨለማ አይደለምን? ፀዳል የሌለውም ድቅድቅ ጨለማ አይደለምን?

verses.en: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
verses.fr: Je hais, je méprise vos fêtes, Je ne puis sentir vos assemblées.
verses.am: ዓመት በዓላችሁን ጠልቼዋለሁ ተጸይፌውማለሁ፤ የተቀደሰውም ጉባኤአችሁ ደስ አያሰኘኝም።

verses.en: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
verses.fr: Quand vous me présentez des holocaustes et des offrandes, Je n''y prends aucun plaisir; Et les veaux engraissés que vous sacrifiez en actions de grâces, Je ne les regarde pas.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁና የእህሉን ቍርባናችሁን ብታቀርቡልኝም እንኳ አልቀበለውም፤ ለምስጋና መሥዋዕት የምታቀርቡልኝን የሰቡትን እንስሶች አልመለከትም።

verses.en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
verses.fr: Eloigne de moi le bruit de tes cantiques; Je n''écoute pas le son de tes luths.
verses.am: የዝማሬህንም ጩኸት ከእኔ ዘንድ አርቅ፤ የመሰንቆህንም ዜማ አላደምጥም።

verses.en: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
verses.fr: Mais que la droiture soit comme un courant d''eau, Et la justice comme un torrent qui jamais ne tarit.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ፍርድ እንደ ውኃ፥ ጽድቅም እንደማይደርቅ ፈሳሽ ይፍሰስ።

verses.en: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
verses.fr: M''avez-vous fait des sacrifices et des offrandes Pendant les quarante années du désert, maison d''Israël?...
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በውኑ በምድረ በዳ አርባ ዓመት ሙሉ መሥዋዕትንና ቍርባንን አቅርባችሁልኛልን?

verses.en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
verses.fr: Emportez donc la tente de votre roi, Le piédestal de vos idoles, L''étoile de votre Dieu Que vous vous êtes fabriqué!
verses.am: ለራሳችሁም የሠራችኋቸውን ምስሎች፥ የሞሎክን ድንኳንና የአምላካችሁን የሬፋን ኮከብ አነሣችሁ።

verses.en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the Lord, whose name is The God of hosts.
verses.fr: Et je vous emmènerai captifs au delà de Damas, Dit l''Eternel, dont le nom est le Dieu des armées.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከደማስቆ ወደዚያ አስማርካችኋለሁ፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት አምላክ የተባለ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui vivent tranquilles dans Sion, Et en sécurité sur la montagne de Samarie, A ces grands de la première des nations, Auprès desquels va la maison d''Israël!...
verses.am: በጽዮን ላሉ ዓለመኞች፥ በሰማርያም ተራራ ላይ ተዘልለው ለተቀመጡ፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት ወደ እነርሱ ለመጡባቸው ለአሕዛብ አለቆች ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
verses.fr: Passez à Calné et voyez, Allez de là jusqu''à Hamath la grande, Et descendez à Gath chez les Philistins: Ces villes sont-elles plus prospères que vos deux royaumes, Et leur territoire est-il plus étendu que le vôtre?...
verses.am: ወደ ካልኔ አልፋችሁ ተመልከቱ፤ ከዚያም ወደ ታላቂቱ ሐማት ሂዱ፤ ከዚያም ወደ ፍልስጥኤም ጌት ውረዱ፤ እነርሱ ከእነዚህ መንግሥታት ይሻላሉን? ወይስ ድንበራቸው ከድንበራችሁ ይሰፋልን?

verses.en: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.fr: Vous croyez éloigné le jour du malheur, Et vous faites approcher le règne de la violence.
verses.am: ክፉውን ቀን ከእናንተ ለምታርቁ፥ የግፍንም ወንበር ለምታቀርቡ፥

verses.en: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
verses.fr: Ils reposent sur des lits d''ivoire, Ils sont mollement étendus sur leurs couches; Ils mangent les agneaux du troupeau, Les veaux mis à l''engrais.
verses.am: ከዝሆን ጥርስ በተሠራ አልጋ ላይ ለምትተኙ፥ በምንጣፋችሁም ላይ ተደላድላችሁ ለምትቀመጡ፥ ከበጎችም መንጋ ጠቦትን ከጋጥም ውስጥ ጥጃን ለምትበሉ፥

verses.en: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
verses.fr: Ils extravaguent au son du luth, Ils se croient habiles comme David sur les instruments de musique.
verses.am: በመሰንቆም ድምፅ ለምትንጫጩ፥ እንደ ዳዊትም የዜማን ዕቃ ለምታዘጋጁ፥

verses.en: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.fr: Ils boivent le vin dans de larges coupes, Ils s''oignent avec la meilleure huile, Et ils ne s''attristent pas sur la ruine de Joseph!
verses.am: በፋጋ የወይን ጠጅ ለምትጠጡ፥ እጅግ ባማረ ሽቱም ለምትቀቡ፥ ስለ ዮሴፍ መከራ ግን ለማታዝኑ ለእናንተ ወዮላችሁ!

verses.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ils seront emmenés à la tête des captifs; Et les cris de joie de ces voluptueux cesseront.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በምርኮ መጀመሪያ ይማረካሉ፥ ተደላድለው ከተቀመጡትም ዘንድ ዘፈን ይርቃል።

verses.en: The Lord God hath sworn by himself, saith the Lord the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, l''a juré par lui-même; L''Eternel, le Dieu des armées, a dit: J''ai en horreur l''orgueil de Jacob, Et je hais ses palais; Je livrerai la ville et tout ce qu''elle renferme.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። የያዕቆብን ትዕቢት ተጸይፌአለሁ፥ አዳራሾቹንም ጠልቻለሁ፤ ስለዚህ ከተማይቱንና የሚኖሩባትን ሁሉ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ ብሎ በራሱ ምሎአል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.fr: Et s''il reste dix hommes dans une maison, ils mourront.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ አሥር ሰዎች በአንድ ቤት ውስጥ ቢቀሩ እነርሱ ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un parent prendra un mort pour le brûler Et qu''il enlèvera de la maison les ossements, Il dira à celui qui est au fond de la maison: Y a-t-il encore quelqu''un avec toi? Et cet homme répondra: Personne... Et l''autre dira: Silence! Ce n''est pas le moment de prononcer le nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አጥንቱንም ከቤቱ ያወጡ ዘንድ የሰው ዘመድና አቃጣዩ ባነሡት ጊዜ፥ በቤቱም ውስጥ ያለውን። እስከ አሁን ድረስ ገና ሰው በአንተ ዘንድ አለን? ባለው ጊዜ፥ እርሱም። ማንም የለም ባለ ጊዜ፤ ያን ጊዜ። የእግዚአብሔርን ስም እንጠራ ዘንድ አይገባንምና ዝም በል ይለዋል።

verses.en: For, behold, the Lord commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
verses.fr: Car voici, l''Eternel ordonne: Il fera tomber en ruines la grande maison, Et en débris la petite maison.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር ያዝዛል፤ ታላቁንም ቤት በማፍረስ፥ ታናሹንም ቤት በመሰባበር ይመታል።

verses.en: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
verses.fr: Est-ce que les chevaux courent sur un rocher, Est-ce qu''on y laboure avec des boeufs, Pour que vous ayez changé la droiture en poison, Et le fruit de la justice en absinthe?
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ ሕዝብን አስነሣባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፤ እነርሱም ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምረው እስከ ዓረባ ወንዝ ድረስ ያስጨንቋችኋል።

verses.en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
verses.fr: Vous vous réjouissez de ce qui n''est que néant, Vous dites: N''est-ce pas par notre force Que nous avons acquis de la puissance?
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ ሕዝብን አስነሣባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፤ እነርሱም ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምረው እስከ ዓረባ ወንዝ ድረስ ያስጨንቋችኋል።

verses.en: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the Lord the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, je ferai lever contre vous, maison d''Israël, Dit l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées, une nation Qui vous opprimera depuis l''entrée de Hamath Jusqu''au torrent du désert.
verses.am: ፤ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ ሕዝብን አስነሣባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፤ እነርሱም ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምረው እስከ ዓረባ ወንዝ ድረስ ያስጨንቋችኋል።

verses.en: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, m''envoya cette vision. Voici, il formait des sauterelles, Au moment où le regain commençait à croître; C''était le regain après la coupe du roi.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አሳየኝ፤ እነሆም፥ የኋለኛው ሣር በሚበቅልበት መጀመሪያ ላይ አንበጣን ፈጠረ፤ እነሆም፥ ከንጉሡ አጨዳ በኋላ የበቀለ የገቦ ነበረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord God, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.fr: Et comme elles dévoraient entièrement l''herbe de la terre, Je dis: Seigneur Eternel, pardonne donc! Comment Jacob subsistera-t-il? Car il est si faible!
verses.am: የምድሩንም ሣር በልተው ከጨረሱ በኋላ፥ እኔ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ይቅር እንድትል እለምንሃለሁ፤ ያዕቆብ ታናሽ ነውና እንዴት ይቆማል? አልሁ።

verses.en: The Lord repented for this: It shall not be, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: L''Eternel se repentit de cela. Cela n''arrivera pas, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ስለዚህ ነገር ተጸጸተ፤ ይህ አይሆንም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord God called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, m''envoya cette vision. Voici, le Seigneur, l''Eternel, proclamait le châtiment par le feu; Et le feu dévorait le grand abîme Et dévorait le champ.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አሳየኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በእሳት ለመፍረድ ጠራ፤ እርስዋም ታላቁን ቀላይና ምድርን በላች።

verses.en: Then said I, O Lord God, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.fr: Je dis: Seigneur Eternel, arrête donc! Comment Jacob subsistera-t-il? Car il est si faible!
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እንድትተው እለምንሃለሁ፤ ያዕቆብ ታናሽ ነውና እንዴት ይቆማል? አልሁ።

verses.en: The Lord repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: L''Eternel se repentit de cela. Cela non plus n''arrivera pas, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ስለዚህ ነገር ተጸጸተ፤ ይህ ደግሞ አይሆንም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
verses.fr: Il m''envoya cette vision. Voici, le Seigneur se tenait sur un mur tiré au cordeau, Et il avait un niveau dans la main.
verses.am: እንዲህም አሳየኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ጌታ ቱንቢውን ይዞ በቱንቢ በተሠራ ቅጥር ላይ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Que vois-tu, Amos? Je répondis: Un niveau. Et le Seigneur dit: Je mettrai le niveau au milieu de mon peuple d''Israël, Je ne lui pardonnerai plus;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። አሞጽ ሆይ፥ የምታየው ምንድር ነው? አለኝ። እኔም። ቱንቢ ነው አልሁ። ጌታም። እነሆ፥ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል መካከል ቱንቢ አደርጋለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ደግሞ አላልፋቸውም፤

verses.en: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
verses.fr: Les hauts lieux d''Isaac seront ravagés; Les sanctuaires d''Israël seront détruits, Et je me lèverai contre la maison de Jéroboam avec l''épée.
verses.am: የይስሐቅም የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ይፈርሳሉ፥ የእስራኤልም መቅደሶች ባድማ ይሆናሉ፤ በኢዮርብዓምም ቤት ላይ በሰይፍ እነሣለሁ አለ።

verses.en: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
verses.fr: Alors Amatsia, prêtre de Béthel, fit dire à Jéroboam, roi d''Israël: Amos conspire contre toi au milieu de la maison d''Israël; le pays ne peut supporter toutes ses paroles.
verses.am: አሜስያስም አሞጽን። ባለ ራእዩ ሆይ፥ ሂድ ወደ ይሁዳም ምድር ሽሽ፥ በዚያም እንጀራን ብላ፥

verses.en: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
verses.fr: Car voici ce que dit Amos: Jéroboam mourra par l''épée, et Israël sera emmené captif loin de son pays.
verses.am: አሜስያስም አሞጽን። ባለ ራእዩ ሆይ፥ ሂድ ወደ ይሁዳም ምድር ሽሽ፥ በዚያም እንጀራን ብላ፥

verses.en: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
verses.fr: Et Amatsia dit à Amos: Homme à visions, va-t-en, fuis dans le pays de Juda; manges-y ton pain, et là tu prophétiseras.
verses.am: በዚያም ትንቢትን ተናገር፤ ነገር ግን ቤቴል የንጉሥ መቅደስና የመንግሥት ቤት ናትና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በዚህ ደግሞ ትንቢት አትናገር አለው።

verses.en: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
verses.fr: Mais ne continue pas à prophétiser à Béthel, car c''est un sanctuaire du roi, et c''est une maison royale.
verses.am: አሞጽም መልሶ አሜስያስን አለው። እኔ ላም ጠባቂና ወርካ ለቃሚ ነኝ እንጂ ነቢይ ወይም የነቢይ ልጅ አይደለሁም፤

verses.en: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
verses.fr: Amos répondit à Amatsia: Je ne suis ni prophète, ni fils de prophète; mais je suis berger, et je cultive des sycomores.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጎቹን ከመከተል ወሰደኝ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። ሂድ፥ ለሕዝቤም ለእስራኤል ትንቢት ተናገር አለኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord took me as I followed the flock, and the Lord said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel m''a pris derrière le troupeau, et l''Eternel m''a dit: Va, prophétise à mon peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: አሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ አንተ። በእስራኤል ላይ ትንቢት አትናገር፥ በይስሐቅም ቤት ላይ አትስበክ ብለሃል፤

verses.en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the Lord: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
verses.fr: Ecoute maintenant la parole de l''Eternel, toi qui dis: Ne prophétise pas contre Israël, et ne parle pas contre la maison d''Isaac.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሚስትህ በከተማይቱ ውስጥ ጋለሞታ ትሆናለች፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህም በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፥ ምድርህም በገመድ ትከፈላለች፤ አንተም በረከሰች ምድር ትሞታለህ፥ እስራኤልም ከምድሩ ተማርኮ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
verses.fr: A cause de cela, voici ce que dit l''Eternel: Ta femme se prostituera dans la ville, tes fils et tes filles tomberont par l''épée, ton champ sera partagé au cordeau; et toi, tu mourras sur une terre impure, et Israël sera emmené captif loin de son pays.
verses.am: ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሚስትህ በከተማይቱ ውስጥ ጋለሞታ ትሆናለች፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህም በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፥ ምድርህም በገመድ ትከፈላለች፤ አንተም በረከሰች ምድር ትሞታለህ፥ እስራኤልም ከምድሩ ተማርኮ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, m''envoya cette vision. Voici, c''était une corbeille de fruits.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አሳየኝ እነሆም፥ የቃርሚያ ፍሬ የሞላበት ዕንቅብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the Lord unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
verses.fr: Il dit: Que vois-tu, Amos? Je répondis: Une corbeille de fruits. Et l''Eternel me dit: La fin est venue pour mon peuple d''Israël; Je ne lui pardonnerai plus.
verses.am: እርሱም። አሞጽ ሆይ፥ የምታየው ምንድር ነው? አለኝ። እኔም። የቃርሚያ ፍሬ የሞላበት ዕንቅብ ነው አልሁት። እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። ፍጻሜ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ መጥቶአል፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ደግሞ አላልፋቸውም።

verses.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord God: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, les chants du palais seront des gémissements, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel; On jettera partout en silence une multitude de cadavres.
verses.am: የመቅደሱ ዝማሬ በዚያ ቀን ዋይታ ይሆናል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ የሰዎችም ሬሳ ይበዛል፥ በስፍራውም ሁሉ በዝምታ ይጣላል።

verses.en: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
verses.fr: Ecoutez ceci, vous qui dévorez l''indigent, Et qui ruinez les malheureux du pays!
verses.am: ችጋረኛውን የምትውጡ፥ የአገሩንም ድሀ የምታጠፉ እናንተ ሆይ።

verses.en: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
verses.fr: Vous dites: Quand la nouvelle lune sera-t-elle passée, Afin que nous vendions du blé? Quand finira le sabbat, afin que nous ouvrions les greniers? Nous diminuerons l''épha, nous augmenterons le prix, Nous falsifierons les balances pour tromper;
verses.am: እህልን እንሸጥ ዘንድ መባቻው መቼ ያልፋል? የኢፍ መስፈሪያውንም እያሳነስን፥ ሰቅሉንም እያበዛን፥ በሐሰተኛም ሚዛን እያታለልን፥

verses.en: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
verses.fr: Puis nous achèterons les misérables pour de l''argent, Et le pauvre pour une paire de souliers, Et nous vendrons la criblure du froment.
verses.am: ድሀውን በብር ችጋረኛውንም በአንድ ጥንድ ጫማ እንገዛ ዘንድ፥ የስንዴውን ግርድ እንሸጥ ዘንድ ስንዴውን እንድንሸምት ሰንበት መቼ ያልፋል? የምትሉ እናንተ ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ።

verses.en: The Lord hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.fr: L''Eternel l''a juré par la gloire de Jacob: Je n''oublierai jamais aucune de leurs oeuvres.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በያዕቆብ ክብር እንዲህ ብሎ ምሎአል። ሥራቸውን ሁሉ ለዘላለም ምንም አልረሳም።

verses.en: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.fr: Le pays, à cause d''elles, ne sera-t-il pas ébranlé, Et tous ses habitants ne seront-ils pas dans le deuil? Le pays montera tout entier comme le fleuve, Il se soulèvera et s''affaissera comme le fleuve d''Egypte.
verses.am: በውኑ ምድሪቱ ስለዚህ ነገር አትናወጥምን? በእርስዋም የሚኖር ሁሉ አያለቅስምን? ሙላዋም እንደ ወንዙ ትነሣለች፤ እንደ ግብጽም ወንዝ ትነሣለች ደግሞም ትወርዳለች።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord God, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, Je ferai coucher le soleil à midi, Et j''obscurcirai la terre en plein jour;
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ፀሐይ በቀትር እንድትገባ አደርጋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ በብርሃንም ቀን ምድሩን አጨልማለሁ።

verses.en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.
verses.fr: Je changerai vos fêtes en deuil, Et tous vos chants en lamentations, Je couvrirai de sacs tous les reins, Et je rendrai chauves toutes les têtes; Je mettrai le pays dans le deuil comme pour un fils unique, Et sa fin sera comme un jour d''amertume.
verses.am: ዓመት በዓላችሁንም ወደ ልቅሶ፥ ዝማሬአችሁንም ወደ ዋይታ እለውጣለሁ፤ ማቅንም በወገብ ሁሉ፥ ራስ መንጨትንም በሁሉ ላይ አመጣለሁ፤ እንደ አንድያ ልጅም ልቅሶ፥ ፍጻሜውንም እንደ መራራ ቀን አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord:
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, Où j''enverrai la famine dans le pays, Non pas la disette du pain et la soif de l''eau, Mais la faim et la soif d''entendre les paroles de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በምድር ላይ ራብን የምሰድድበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ እርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ከመስማት እንጂ እንጀራን ከመራብና ውኃን ከመጠማት አይደለም።

verses.en: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.
verses.fr: Ils seront alors errants d''une mer à l''autre, Du septentrion à l''orient, Ils iront çà et là pour chercher la parole de l''Eternel, Et ils ne la trouveront pas.
verses.am: ከባሕርም እስከ ባሕር ድረስ፥ ከሰሜንም እስከ ምሥራቅ ድረስ ይቅበዘበዛሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ለመሻት ይርዋርዋጣሉ፥ አያገኙትምም።

verses.en: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
verses.fr: En ce jour, les belles jeunes filles et les jeunes hommes mourront de soif.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን መልካካሞች ደናግል ጐበዛዝትም በጥም ይዝላሉ።

verses.en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beersheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
verses.fr: Ils jurent par le péché de Samarie, Et ils disent: Vive ton Dieu, Dan! Vive la voie de Beer-Schéba! Mais ils tomberont, et ne se relèveront plus.
verses.am: በሰማርያ ኃጢአት የሚምሉና። ዳን ሆይ፥ ሕያው አምላክህን! ደግሞ። ሕያው የቤርሳቤህን መንገድ! ብለው የሚሉ፥ እነርሱ ይወድቃሉ፥ ደግሞም አይነሡም።

verses.en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
verses.fr: Je vis le Seigneur qui se tenait sur l''autel. Et il dit: Frappe les chapiteaux et que les seuils s''ébranlent, Et brise-les sur leurs têtes à tous! Je ferai périr le reste par l''épée. Aucun d''eux ne pourra se sauver en fuyant, Aucun d''eux n''échappera.
verses.am: ጌታን በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ አየሁት፤ እርሱም እንዲህ አለ። መድረኮቹ ይናወጡ ዘንድ ጕልላቶቹን ምታ፥ በራሳቸውም ሁሉ ላይ ሰባብራቸው፤ እኔም ከእነርሱ የቀሩትን በሰይፍ እገድላለሁ፤ የሚሸሽ አያመልጥም፥ የሚያመልጥም አይድንም።

verses.en: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
verses.fr: S''ils pénètrent dans le séjour des morts, Ma main les en arrachera; S''ils montent aux cieux, Je les en ferai descendre.
verses.am: ወደ ሲኦል ቢወርዱ እጄ ከዚያ ታወጣቸዋለች፤ ወደ ሰማይም ቢወጡ ከዚያ አወርዳቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
verses.fr: S''ils se cachent au sommet du Carmel, Je les y chercherai et je les saisirai; S''ils se dérobent à mes regards dans le fond de la mer, Là j''ordonnerai au serpent de les mordre.
verses.am: በቀርሜሎስም ራስ ውስጥ ቢሸሸጉ ፈልጌ ከዚያ አወጣቸዋለሁ፤ በጥልቅ ባሕርም ውስጥ ከዓይኔ ቢደበቁ ከዚያ እባቡን አዝዛለሁ፥ እርሱም ይነድፋቸዋል፤

verses.en: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
verses.fr: S''ils vont en captivité devant leurs ennemis, Là j''ordonnerai à l''épée de les faire périr; Je dirigerai contre eux mes regards Pour faire du mal et non du bien.
verses.am: በጠላቶቻቸውም ፊት ተማርከው ቢሄዱ ከዚያ ሰይፍን አዝዛለሁ፥ እርሱም ይገድላቸዋል፤ ዓይኔንም በእነርሱ ላይ ለክፋት እንጂ ለመልካም አላደርግም።

verses.en: And the Lord God of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, touche la terre, et elle tremble, Et tous ses habitants sont dans le deuil; Elle monte tout entière comme le fleuve, Et elle s''affaisse comme le fleuve d''Egypte.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ይዳስሳል እርስዋም ትቀልጣለች፥ የሚኖሩባትም ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ፤ ሙላዋም እንደ ግብጽ ወንዝ ትነሣለች፥ ደግሞ እንደ ግብጽ ወንዝ ትወርዳለች።

verses.en: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name.
verses.fr: Il a bâti sa demeure dans les cieux, Et fondé sa voûte sur la terre; Il appelle les eaux de la mer, Et les répand à la surface de la terre: L''Eternel est son nom.
verses.am: አዳራሹን በሰማይ የሠራ፥ ጠፈሩንም በምድር ላይ የመሠረተ፥ የባሕርንም ውኃ ጠርቶ በምድር ፊት ላይ የሚያፈስሰው እርሱ ነው፤ ስሙም እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the Lord. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
verses.fr: N''êtes-vous pas pour moi comme les enfants des Ethiopiens, Enfants d''Israël? dit l''Eternel. N''ai-je pas fait sortir Israël du pays d''Egypte, Comme les Philistins de Caphtor et les Syriens de Kir?
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ እናንተ ለእኔ እንደ ኢትዮጵያ ልጆች አይደላችሁምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር። እስራኤልን ከግብጽ ምድር፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ከከፍቶር፥ ሶርያውያንንም ከቂር አላወጣሁምን?

verses.en: Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici, le Seigneur, l''Eternel, a les yeux sur le royaume coupable. Je le détruirai de dessus la face de la terre; Toutefois je ne détruirai pas entièrement la maison de Jacob, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች በኃጢአተኛ መንግሥት ላይ ናቸው፥ ከምድርም ፊት አጠፋታለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የያዕቆብን ቤት ፈጽሜ አላጠፋም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
verses.fr: Car voici, je donnerai mes ordres, Et je secouerai la maison d''Israël parmi toutes les nations, Comme on secoue avec le crible, Sans qu''il tombe à terre un seul grain.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አዝዛለሁ፥ እህልም በወንፊት እንዲነፋ የእስራኤልን ቤት በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል እነፋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አንዲት ቅንጣት በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።

verses.en: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
verses.fr: Tous les pécheurs de mon peuple mourront par l''épée, Ceux qui disent: Le malheur n''approchera pas, ne nous atteindra pas.
verses.am: ክፉው ነገር አይደርስብንም፥ አያገኘንምም የሚሉ የሕዝቤ ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, je relèverai de sa chute la maison de David, J''en réparerai les brèches, j''en redresserai les ruines, Et je la rebâtirai comme elle était autrefois,
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን የወደቀችውን የዳዊትን ድንኳን አነሣለሁ፥ የተናደውንም ቅጥርዋን እጠግናለሁ፤ የፈረሰውንም አድሳለሁ፥ እንደ ቀደመውም ዘመን እሠራታለሁ፤

verses.en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the Lord that doeth this.
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils possèdent le reste d''Edom et toutes les nations Sur lesquelles mon nom a été invoqué, Dit l''Eternel, qui accomplira ces choses.
verses.am: ይኸውም የኤዶምያስን ቅሬታ፥ ስሜም የተጠራባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ይወርሱ ዘንድ ነው፥ ይላል ይህን የሚያደርግ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où le laboureur suivra de près le moissonneur, Et celui qui foule le raisin celui qui répand la semence, Où le moût ruissellera des montagnes Et coulera de toutes les collines.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አራሹ አጫጁን፥ ወይን ጠማቂውም ዘሪውን የሚያገኝበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ተራሮችም በተሀውን የወይን ጠጅ ያንጠባጥባሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ይቀልጣሉ።

verses.en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.fr: Je ramènerai les captifs de mon peuple d''Israël; Ils rebâtiront les villes dévastées et les habiteront, Ils planteront des vignes et en boiront le vin, Ils établiront des jardins et en mangeront les fruits.
verses.am: የሕዝቤን የእስራኤልን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ የፈረሱትንም ከተሞች ሠርተው ይቀመጡባቸዋል፤ ወይንንም ይተክላሉ፥ የወይን ጠጁንም ይጠጣሉ፤ አታክልትንም ያባጃሉ፥ ፍሬውንም ይበላሉ።

verses.en: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Je les planterai dans leur pays, Et ils ne seront plus arrachés du pays que je leur ai donné, Dit L''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: በምድራቸውም እተክላቸዋለሁ፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ከሰጠኋቸው ከምድራቸው አይነቀሉም፥ ይላል አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር
